events.body:
## Upgrade vulnerable dependencies

This PR upgrades **6** packages in `shareAI-lab__learn-claude-code/web` with known security advisories, each to the release that fixes the most of them while being at least 7 days old (brand-new releases are where supply-chain attacks land).

| Package | From | To | Released | Fixes | Still open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline-browser-mapping` | 2.9.19 | **2.11.0** | 99 days ago | [CVE-2026-45819](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45819) | - |
| `esbuild` | 0.27.3 | **0.28.1** | 139 days ago | [GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr) | - |
| `next` | 16.1.6 | **16.4.1** | 14 days ago | [GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw), [CVE-2026-44575](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44575), [CVE-2026-45109](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45109), [GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4), [CVE-2026-44573](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44573), [CVE-2026-94486](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-94486) and 32 more | - |
| `postcss` | 8.4.31 | **8.5.23** | 96 days ago | [CVE-2026-45623](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45623), [CVE-2026-69153](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69153), [CVE-2026-41305](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41305), [CVE-2026-73646](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-73646) | - |
| `sharp` | 0.34.5 | **0.35.5** | 31 days ago | [CVE-2026-114113](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114113), [CVE-2026-114112](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114112), [CVE-2026-114111](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114111) | - |
| `source-map-js` | 1.2.1 | **1.2.2** | 28 days ago | [CVE-2026-93749](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-93749) | - |

### Dependency files

- `web/package-lock.json`: rewritten by npm
- `web/package.json`: the new version ranges, or an override for a package that another one pulls in

Lockfiles were resolved in a throwaway container that held back releases under 7 days old, and every version they add was checked against its registry's release date.

### What changed upstream

Quoted from each package's own changelog (found and read with Tavily), for the releases between the two versions:

- **baseline-browser-mapping** 2.9.19 → 2.11.0: 2 releases, from [baseline-browser-mapping releases](https://github.com/web-platform-dx/baseline-browser-mapping/releases); none of them says anything was removed or now works differently
- **esbuild** 0.27.3 → 0.28.1: 5 releases, from [esbuild changelog](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)
  - 0.28.1: “* Fix renaming of nested `var` declarations (#4471) This release fixes a bug where `var` declarations in nested scopes that are hoisted up to module scope were not correctly being renamed during bundling. That could previously lead to name collisions when minification was disabled, which could pote…”
- **postcss** 8.4.31 → 8.5.23: 42 releases, from [postcss changelog](https://github.com/postcss/postcss/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)
  - 8.4.45: “Removed unnecessary fix which could lead to infinite loop.”
  - 8.4.47: “Removed debug code.”
- **sharp** 0.34.5 → 0.35.5: 4 releases, from [sharp releases](https://github.com/lovell/sharp/releases)
  - 0.35.5: “TypeScript: Remove non-existent named export. #4604”
- **source-map-js** 1.2.1 → 1.2.2: 1 release, from [source-map-js changelog](https://github.com/7rulnik/source-map-js/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md); none of them says anything was removed or now works differently

### Tests

| | Result |
|---|---|
| Before the upgrade | ✅ CI passed: npm ci, tsc --noEmit, next build |
| After the version bump | ❌ Error: page.tsx doesn't have a root layout. To fix this error, make sure every page has a root layout. |
| After OpenPort's fix 1 | ❌ Error: Module not found: Can't resolve '../globals.css' |
| After OpenPort's fix 2 | ✅ CI passed: npm ci, tsc --noEmit, next build |

### Code changes

The upgrade broke the tests, so Nemotron Ultra changed the application code (never the tests):

- `src/app/layout.tsx`: Next.js 16.4.1 Turbopack now strictly requires a root layout (src/app/layout.tsx) for every page including the root redirect page; the minimal valid root layout passes children through without rendering html/body since the locale layout handles that.
- Tried first and undone, because the tests still failed: Nemotron Super's change to `src/app/layout.tsx` (The root page src/app/page.tsx lacks a root layout, causing a Turbopack build error. We fix this by creating a root layout at src/app/layout.tsx (copied from the existing locale layout) and emptying the locale layout to prevent duplicate HTML structure.).
- 1 proposed edit(s) weren't applied: `src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx` (the text to replace appears 0 times, not once).

### Not upgraded here

- `postcss` 8.5.6: postcss 8.5.6 is also locked here; this upgrade moves the other one only

---
Opened by OpenPort. Never auto-merged: review the changes and the test results above.
